newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, petchem demand still strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, petchem demand still strong.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices held notionally steady at high levels on Monday morning, showing no signs of the expected downturn for reforming grades, traders said.
On the barges, full-range product was offered at fob quotes high +$1, with good buying interest seen from petchem buyers.
Swaps were discussed $3 higher at $200/$222 cif NWE for Oct and $211/$213 for Nov.

Traders said that although Algeria's Skikda terminal remains closed due to bad weather, any loading delays should be compensated by several Russian open-spec cargoes which are expected in NWE this week.
